_about: Verified product facts. Every 'answer' here is taken from the published SimpliEd website (simpliedtech.com). Do not add claims that are not published or confirmed by the SimpliEd team.

entries.title: What is SimpliEd
entries.answer:
**SimpliEd is an all-in-one school operating system.** It unifies admissions, billing, teaching and parent communication into one platform your whole institution can use.

• A Parent app, a Teacher app and a Smart Inbox
• An admin command center for leaders
• Built by an educator, engineered for education

entries.title: Main features
entries.answer:
SimpliEd covers:

• Admissions & student information
• Attendance
• Timetable
• Fees & billing (with Stripe online payments)
• Communication (Smart Inbox)
• LMS, homework & assignments
• Reports & multi-branch command center
• AI integration

entries.title: Admissions & student information
entries.answer:
SimpliEd brings **admissions and student information** into the same platform as billing, teaching and communication.

• One record per student, shared across every module
• Multi-branch ready, with campus-wise visibility
• Less re-typing between separate systems

entries.title: Attendance
examples: Can teachers take attendance on the app?
entries.answer:
**Attendance takes one tap.** Teachers mark Present, Late or Absent from the Teacher app, and parents are told when the teacher presses **Notify parents**.

• Parents see attendance at a glance in their app
• Leaders see live attendance in the admin command center

entries.title: Timetable
entries.answer: Parents and students see the **timetable at a glance** in the SimpliEd app, and teachers see their **teaching day at a glance**: what's next, which class and which room.

entries.title: Fees & billing
entries.answer:
SimpliEd's **automated billing** is built for schools:

• Generate fee invoices for a student, a class or an entire campus in one click
• Every parent gets an instant push notification
• Every IBFT and online payment reconciles automatically to the right student and branch
• Remind pending families in one tap
• Secure online payments via the **Stripe** integration

entries.title: Communication (Smart Inbox)
examples: How do you replace WhatsApp groups?
Can we send announcements to parents?
entries.answer:
The **SimpliEd Smart Inbox** replaces scattered WhatsApp groups with one secure, school-owned channel:

• Category routing to the right conversation
• Auto-escalation when no one replies
• Full admin transparency on every thread
• Circulars, news and events on one home screen
• Instant announcements with read receipts

entries.title: LMS, homework & assignments
examples: Do you support homework and assignments?
entries.answer:
The built-in **LMS** keeps learning in one place:

• Lessons, resources, homework and assignments
• Lesson plans, class streams and materials
• Track every submission: assigned, submitted, graded
• Digital grading and automated results

entries.title: Reports, insights & multi-branch
examples: We have several branches, can we see them all?
entries.answer:
Leaders run the whole school from **one command center**:

• Attendance, announcements, LMS, billing and insights in one place
• Real-time, branch-wise visibility and control
• Live insights so principals and owners act on facts, not guesswork

entries.title: Apps for each role
entries.answer:
SimpliEd gives every role a focused view:

• **Parents**: circulars, attendance, timetable, fees and results; multiple children from one login
• **Teachers**: teaching day, attendance, lesson plans, digital grading
• **Students**: timetable and learning
• **Admin**: the full command center

entries.title: AI integration
entries.answer:
SimpliEd includes **AI integration**: AI-assisted insights and smart automation built into everyday school workflows, so your team spends less time on routine work.

Our team can show exactly how it works in a demo.

entries.title: Integrations
examples: Can it connect to our accounting system?
entries.answer:
SimpliEd supports **secure online payments via Stripe**, and every IBFT and online payment reconciles automatically.

For other systems you'd like to connect, our team can confirm what's possible for your school.

entries.title: Security & privacy
entries.answer:
Communication runs through **one secure, school-owned channel** instead of personal WhatsApp groups, and admins have full transparency on every thread.

For detailed questions about data security and hosting, our team can give you accurate answers.

entries.title: Founder
entries.answer:
SimpliEd was founded by **Mr. Rehman Minhas**, an educator with a Masters in Educational Leadership from **Harvard University** and a Masters in Private School Leadership from **Columbia University**.

His goal: world-class systems for every school, and leadership driven by data.

entries.title: Customers
entries.answer: SimpliEd is used by schools from single campuses to multi-branch school groups, including **Foundation Public School**, **Head Start School**, **Willow Academy**, **Building Blocks** and **Prime Blessings**.

entries.title: Results after implementation
entries.answer:
Schools report these results after implementation (as published on our website):

• On-time fee collection **up 46%**
• IT cost **down 53%**
• Operational cost **down 30%**
• New students **up 33%**
